title: imported.json
description: The record of the last import of checked capability rows. schema is the record's version (scripts/build.py IMPORT_SCHEMAS lists those it understands); checked_rows and content_hash are the number and sha256 of the checked rows of the file, one line measure,tool,state,comparisons_agreeing,comparisons_differing per row sorted by measure then tool. The build recomputes both, so a hand edit of an imported field or a partial import fails it; curated fields (api_names, source, reported-in-docs rows) are not covered.
